# Roadmap and delivery

Use this skill when turning approved opportunities into transformation
initiatives and measuring delivery. An initiative retains its originating
opportunity context and models scope, owner, actions, milestones, dependencies,
status, cost, expected benefits, actual benefits, risks, decisions, and
outcomes.

Keep expected benefits separate from realised benefits and distinguish plans
from evidence of impact. Preserve links from initiative to opportunity,
engagement, actions, and outputs. Fabric should manage transformation delivery,
not become a generic project-management suite; prefer context, sequencing,
dependencies, and measurable outcomes over task volume.
